title: Aromatic Adventurous Syrian Lentil Kebabs
description: A sour and crisp Syrian dish featuring sumac and spherified lentils, perfect for adventurous eaters, this vegan-friendly recipe is a must try for anyone looking to spice up their meal routine.
instructions: In a large bowl, soak the lentils in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine the soaked lentils, sumac, lemon juice, olive oil, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Stir in the sodium alginate and let the mixture sit for 10 minutes to allow it to thicken.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the lentil mixture into a bath of cold water to spherify them.
Once the lentil balls have firmed up, remove them from the water and thread them onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional sumac and a squeeze of lemon juice if desired.
